description.value: Leopold's Tavern is a proudly Canadian-owned neighbourhood bar chain with a Victoria location, focused on classic comfort food, good beer, and community. The bar operates under an explicit safe-space policy welcoming all guests regardless of religion, race, gender, or physical ability. Kids are welcome with an adult until 8 PM, and food is available for dine-in, takeout, or delivery via major platforms.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms Leopold's Tavern is an active Canadian-owned bar chain with a Victoria location listed on the help/locations page. The FAQ explicitly states 'There are currently no phones at any Leo's location,' explaining the absent OSM phone field. Takeout and delivery are confirmed via the 'LEO'S TO GO' section; a plant-based burger option confirms at least one vegetarian/vegan item. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: No phone number available at any Leo's location by company policy — this is intentional, not a data gap.
Chain with many locations across Canada; OSM record and website do not provide the specific street address for the Victoria location to cross-check against OSM's 570 Yates Street.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bar with confirmed Victoria location; a valid stop for a touring cyclist seeking food, drink, or takeout.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Late-night menu lists a plant-based version of the $5 Smash Burger Jr.; allergen filtering tool available on menu page
